key_features: SQLAlchemy 2.0 async models: User, Role, Computer, Component, Rental, RentalItem, Notification, Schedule
Pydantic v2 schemas with validation for all entities
FastAPI routers for CRUD: auth, users, computers, components, rentals, notifications, schedules
JWT authentication with bcrypt password hashing and role-based access control
APScheduler jobs: daily 08:00 check for expiring rentals (1-7 days), hourly check for today's rentals, 30-min overdue check, hourly auto-complete
Multi-channel notification service: Email (SMTP), Telegram Bot, In-app WebSocket real-time
Alembic migrations with initial schema for all tables
Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml for containerized deployment
Role-based access: Admin, Staff, Customer with appropriate permissions
next_steps: Configure .env with actual database credentials, SMTP settings, and Telegram bot token
Start backend: uvicorn app.main:app --reload or docker-compose up -d backend
Create initial admin user via POST /auth/register
